name: Honey
overview: Scripture portrays honey as a symbol of God's provision and blessing, describing the Promised Land as flowing with milk and honey, a place of abundance and nourishment (Exodus 3:8; Leviticus 20:24). Honey is depicted as a wholesome and desirable food, likened to the taste of manna, which sustained Israel in the wilderness (Exodus 16:31). While honey was valued and even sent as a gift, it was not to be used in offerings to the Lord, emphasizing the holiness required in worship (Leviticus 2:11; Genesis 43:11). Additionally, honey was a notable product of the land, associated with agricultural richness alongside wheat, barley, and olives (Deuteronomy 8:8).
